meta.name: remove-code
meta.description: Remove a feature, delete dead code, drop a dependency, or simplify an abstraction. Use when the user wants to delete or clean up code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理并删除不再需要的代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要删除或清理代码
copy.tagline_en: Clean up and delete unnecessary code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to delete or clean up code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你安全删除代码。它会先分析要删除的功能及其依赖，列出所有相关文件，等你确认后再执行删除，并自动验证是否还有残留引用。
howto.when: 当你想删除功能、清理死代码、移除依赖或简化抽象时，Claude 会接管并按照删除流程操作。

say.text: 帮我删除用户注册功能
移除已废弃的支付模块
say.note: Claude 会追踪支付模块的依赖，安全移除相关代码。
Claude 会查找并移除不再需要的依赖及引用。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill makes Claude help you safely delete code: analyze the capability to remove, trace dependencies, list all related files, wait for your review, execute deletion, and verify no lingering references remain.
howto.when_en: When you ask to remove a feature, delete dead code, drop a dependency, or simplify an abstraction, Claude takes over with a structured deletion process.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze all dependencies of registration and list files for review.
Claude traces payment module dependencies and removes them safely.
Claude finds and removes unused packages and their references.
